Walk.use: in-place walk; translate root at walk_speed_mps along facing

Work_Cannon.use: crouched gun adjust/push; place facing the carriage, hands ~0.6-0.9m work height

Work_Ropes.use: hand-over-hand line hauling, gaze up; place facing pin rail / shroud base

Climb.use: in-place ratline climb; translate along climb path at climb_speed_mps (one cycle = ~0.30m, scale playback to match)

Sit.use: bench sit; hips at sit_seat_height_m above the node origin - align origin to deck in front of bench

Lookout.use: hand shading eyes, slow horizon scan; bow/masthead stations

Death.use: stagger+collapse onto back; play once then hold last frame or switch to Dead

Dead.use: lying corpse pose; also for spawning already-dead

death_footprint.note: Death/Dead: pelvis stays near node origin; head extends ~0.75m toward -Z (behind), feet ~0.85m toward +Z. Ensure ~1.8m x 0.8m clear deck or accept overlap.

variants.how: One material per slot is embedded (the defaults below). Per crew member: clone the slot material(s) and override albedo (garments) or albedoTexture (skin). All values are linear RGB.

linked_slot.note: fall flap = breeches color x 0.75 per channel

headwear.rule: enable at most ONE (or none for bareheaded); all are exported visible - hide the rest on spawn

crew_randomization.recipe: per crew member: rng = mulberry32(shipSeed * 31 + crewIndex); pick skin=rng()%4, shirt=rng()%4, breeches=rng()%4, boots=rng()%3, headwear=rng()%5. Deterministic across clients from one synced shipSeed.
crew_randomization.combinations: 4 skins x 4 shirts x 4 breeches x 3 boots x 5 headwear = 960 distinct crew

notes: All clips key every joint - no residual-pose leakage; safe to switch/blend arbitrarily.
All clips are in-place (no root motion). Walk/Climb: move the instance's parent transform.
Parent each crew instance to the SHIP node so deck pitch/roll is inherited for free.
Headwear + Eyes are rigid children of the Head joint, not skinned.
Skin texture has lips/stubble/brows baked in; all 4 skin PNGs ship in textures/.
Spawn pattern: loader.instantiateModelsToScene or AssetContainer per crew member; clone slot materials before tinting so instances don't share.
Joint influences were capped at 4 per vertex on export (normalized) - cosmetic-only difference.
